name: Leopardmon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 5000 DP or lower Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, all of your level 3 or higher Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until your opponent's turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your other Digimon would leave the battle area, gain 2 memory.
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
